flags.reason: stronger-than-source: The guide's "Show only the last four digits of the account number" is an ordinary content directive, like "Keep values short" (marked recommended). Here "only" says which digits to show; it is not an absolute that applies everywhere. No package fact enforces masking, so [required] overstates it.

misreads-source: The reason given for not leaving out the logo is the Do caption ("institutionAvatar shows the bank’s own mark"). The guide's actual reason is the Don't caption: "The card falls back to a stranger’s photo." /doDont/1's why repeats the same Do caption instead of that consequence.

notes: Several type-sourced facts contradict the guide and evidence (checked 19 October on a116616). This may be because the types come from the newer dbe0e02 install, whose #344 changes the guide copy 'wasn't re-checked' against. (1) buttonDisabled (/configuration/20, /states/2) contradicts the guide's "The card can’t disable its button" and the evidence's "no way to disable the footer Button". (2) The disableTruncation fact says it reaches the header name, badge and button (/configuration/21). Evidence says it affects value text only. (3) institutionName default "", items with no placeholder, and buttonLabel hiding the button when omitted (/configuration/17–19) contradict the guide's sources section and evidence, which report placeholder copy ('State Bank of India', 'Korem ipsum', 'Button'). The guide and the package types disagree, so a human should confirm which build the entry targets before publishing.
